type: independent full-set re-verification + one end-to-end origin re-download (no new files to retrieve)
context: Continuation prompt carried a stale baseline of 35 published / 25 remaining and warned that a registry smoke artifact is not hash verification. GHCR ground truth shows all 60 per-file tags present; this iteration independently re-proved it rather than trusting the prior state file.

ghcrTagDigestResolve.command: oras repo tags + oras resolve per tag via tools/nauka/ghcr.mjs

fullSetColdRoundTrip.method: for each of the 60 per-file tags: oras resolve digest, oras pull the tag, sha256 of pulled bytes vs recorded sha256, digest vs recorded immutable digest

contentSample.method: oras pull + sha256 + byte count vs state for a spread of files incl. the largest

discoveryRecheck.method: re-parse preserved windows-1251 index (sha256 e24f0a5d...) with parse-index.mjs and diff vs tools/nauka/manifest.json

endToEndOriginRedownload.method: fresh throttled ranged-chunk download from origin into an isolated NAUKA_DATA_DIR, assembled, sha256 computed

originValidatorSpotCheck.method: 1-byte ranged GET (bytes=0-0) per file with a 2.2 s request-start gate; compare status/Content-Range total/ETag/Last-Modified against state
originValidatorSpotCheck.note: All six returned HTTP 206 with total size, ETag and Last-Modified identical to state; no origin drift for the set.

nextAction: Objective complete and independently re-verified in iteration 3-11 from GHCR ground truth (60/60 tags + full cold rehash) and origin bytes. No retrieval remains. A future runner need only spot-check; no republishing required.
